about_the_game:
A CHARMING MEMORY GAME TO MAKE YOU FALL IN LOVE

Find My Love is a beautiful memory game based on the traditional card game called "Jogo do Mico" ("Game of Monkey" in english) that was very popular in Brazil on 80´s and 90´s decades. Different from conventional memory games which you must find two same cards, in this game no card is equal to anyother. The game rules is just simple: you must find couples and get points. Find the King and Queen, the Prince and Princess, the Cowboy and Cowgirl, the Groom and Bride... and many other couples that truly loves each other. But be careful! If you flip the "monkey" card twice you lose the game and must restart the level you are. In Find My Love the "monkey" card is represented by the card "The bad ideologist". Dont let any evil ideology destroy the pretty love of these couples, find each couple and help then to stay together until death do them part.

If you want play without any worries about flipping the "monkey" card, you can play in Relax Mode, in this mode there is no "dark card" on table, you will never lose. Just relax, enjoy the beautiful songs and find the couples.

This is the first game of Araujo Castle Games. We created beautiful art and a loving atmosphere for you enjoy, relax and have fun while playing Find My Love.

Features:

  • Beautiful images and characters in anime style

  • 13 beautiful backgrounds, some static, some others tileables and moving.

  • Beautiful, happy, relaxing, lovely and romantic songs.

  • 49 cards in total. 24 male cards, 24 female cards and 1 monkey card called "the bad ideologist".

  • Simple Rules: Just find the couples and be careful to flip the monkey card twice.

  • Relax Mode: No monkey card on table, just relax and find the couples.

  • 10 levels in normal mode. Each level more harder than the previous level, with more cards on table. Can you win all?

  • 3 levels in Relax Mode: Levels with 12 cards, 24 cards and 48 cards.

I´m sure you will fall in love for Find My Love!
